node.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

processId.description: The decimal Queue Manager id: processId from find_processes (queueLog workflowId); a UUID globalProcessId is not accepted

confirmationCode.description: The code from the preview of the first call; executes the restart

reason.description: Why this action is taken; stored in the audit log
